blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday called for deeper partnerships in maritime trade and logistics, among other areas, with the three largest East Asian economies to cushion the impact of crises and geopolitical tensions that have slowed economic growth. At the Asean Plus Three (APT) Summit, Marcos, who co-chaired the meeting, joined the leaders of Japan, the Republic of Korea and China in looking back at the history of their cooperation, which will mark its 30th anniversary next year. The APT Summit opened the activities on the third and final day of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) […]...
